name: Anoka County, MN
findings: Anoka County has 988 nonprofit organizations. 487 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 374 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Anoka County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few health care organizations list membership
observations.text: 6 health care organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 14 would.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through health care groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 52 hobby and sports organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 52 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do hobby and sports organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
